what: Clicking a link opens its address in a panel (iframe) over the current page. The panel rises from the bottom edge with clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0)→0 over .7s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1), covers the screen, and a 60px dark bar (a ”Back” pill and the title) sits on top. Once the page inside starts painting, the spinning ring fades out in .3s and the page turns on in .35s. The Back button, Esc (even when pressed inside the panel) and the browser back button lower it with the same curve, and the site underneath is exactly where you left it (smooth scroll pauses → restarts). Hovering or focusing prefetches that address

options.title: Title at the right of the band, default first line of the link text
options.ease: Curve as four numbers (like 0.7,0,0.2,1), default original curve
options.hash: The #name added to the address when opened — if set, Back closes it and you can enter directly at that address

use: …

from.where: index.html work cards .nn-proj · résumé link in the contact section — original .cs case viewer: clip-path .7s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1), 60px bar, iframe .35s, ring .8s linear, Esc·popstate·#work/<slug>, prefetch on hover

note: If the page inside the panel is cross-origin, Esc inside the panel can’t be heard. The original’s exception for phones, which can’t show a PDF in the panel (it opens a new window), is left out — don’t attach it to PDF links
